Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped in the right lane of a city street in Houston, Texas, waiting for traffic ahead to clear, when the
vehicle behind them, operated by Driver 2, struck the rear of Driver 1's car. Driver 2 told me the impact occurred
because they did not stop in time, and this account matches what was described by two independent witnesses at the
scene. Both witnesses saw the collision and stated that it happened as the drivers described it. Photographs taken at
the scene show damage to the rear bumper and trunk of Driver 1's vehicle, and the location and pattern of that
damage are consistent with a rear impact of this force. Officers found no sign of earlier damage to the vehicle. A
Passenger was also in Driver 1's car, and both the responding officers and the witnesses confirmed that person was
present during the crash. Driver 1 complained of neck pain and stiffness and said they felt whiplash symptoms within
hours. Those complaints are consistent with the mechanics of this type of collision. Driver 1 is named on the
insurance policy covering the vehicle.
